Captain Jake and Captain Sam told me that I needed to practice with this list because they need me to be the designated "Hulk Smash" guy on their teams later this month.

What I wanted to run this weekend was a flock of pyramids, but the Captains said "NOOO, you need to stay on the drug that is Sustained/Lethal 5+ with full hit rerolls, because you fuck when you're on it."

To be fair, that is one hell of a drug.

It has been 23 days since I smoked Fulgrim in one glorious go, and I now live for that high.

Oh well, rehab is for quitters and mama didn't raise no bitch.

Also. Don't ever smoke Fulgrim. A three eyed technicolor walrus that walks around on the ceiling shows up as you come down off of the high, and he won't leave. Nice guy though. We're going to Spain in December. (1995 points)
